newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA AND HOIU EYE AGRICULTURAL BANK - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: HANSA AND HOIU EYE AGRICULTURAL BANK - REPORT.

text.p: Hansabank and Hoiupank, Estonia's leading commercial banks, are both interested in acquiring a major stake in Lithuania's Agricultural Bank, Aripaev newspaper said on Wednesday.
The state-run Agricultural Bank is the best of the banks up for sale because its market is share is 21 percent, Ago Lauri of Hoiupank Investments was quoted as saying.
The Lithuanian government has announced its plans to privatise the bank this year.
An Agricultural Bank spokesperson told Aripaev that the EBRD and Hansapank have recently shown serious interest in the bank. Hansabank is analysing its economic situation, the spokesperson added.
Hoiupank plans to invest up to 70 million kroons in Lithuania. It is also in talks with Ukio bank, which has a market share of three percent, Aripaev reported.
